comparison.objective: Remove a protective cap, insert a missing spacer washer over a post, and replace the cap; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Reference-based disassembly, annular alignment/insertion, and reassembly versus coaxial mandrel placement, impact fracture, withdrawal, and debris recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Washer restored under the cap with fixture stabilized and both hands released; detailed pose/damage thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four tang fractures, retained insert poses, and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Fine annular alignment is related only at a generic level; washer installation/reassembly does not test impact-driven sacrificial-feature removal.
